correctness.rationale: For \(0<\lambda\le1/2\), Theorem 5.2 of Liu--Sarfraz--Li gives \(J(\lambda,X_8)\le \lambda J(X_8)+1-2\lambda\). Two independent published descriptions identify the regular octagonal model with \(J(X_8)=\sqrt2\). The explicit unit pair \(x=(-(\sqrt2-1),1)\), \(y=(1,\sqrt2-1)\) makes both weighted norms equal \(1-(2-\sqrt2)\lambda\); the diagonal-facet inequality is proved on the two exact sign intervals. Symmetry gives the remainder. The packaged symbolic replay verifies all algebraic identities without using finite sampling as proof.

value.rationale: The weighted James profile is a natural complete invariant introduced to refine the classical James constant. The regular octagon is a canonical non-Hilbert two-dimensional model sharing the classical value \(\sqrt2\) with Hilbert space. The exact all-parameter formula both certifies sharpness of the source paper's universal upper estimate and shows that the weighted profile distinguishes these two geometries. This is a complete benchmark with structural content, not a routine one-parameter sample or arbitrary slice.
